findings.statement: A known Arrhenius-family model is a compact repeat-test reference; extra yield/shear terms add essentially no gain.

reliability.rationale: The retained evidence supports the stated narrow conclusion under Whole tests of already calibrated formulations; static and previous-temperature-history tasks have distinct input budgets. Strong adverse evidence: Group errors 43.9–15958 cP and thermal ordering/aging confounding preclude a clean universal filler law.

mechanism.rationale: Temperature activation is plausible but heating order, aging, anomalous instrument values and shear mismatch are unresolved.

novelty.rationale: Arrhenius, Cross and Carreau families are prior art; no supported new constitutive extension. This review uses retained prior-art records only; it performs no new literature priority adjudication.
